GIN.note: Training is for students, young people and women, not civil servants.

facts.fact: TechAfrica News reports the Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and the Digital Economy and ANSUTEN launched the third edition of the R-CUN digital capacity building programme on 7 October 2025, after two editions that trained 450 young people, aiming to train 1,500 students; no second location is named for the programme.

systems.owner: ANSUTEN and Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and the Digital Economy

GIN.note: Mentions a national digital transformation strategy only in passing; no standing, text, period or reporting stated.
